tagline: Turning curiosity into creations, and creations into stories.
bio: An apprentice magician living in the forests of Gensokyo who, in the outside world, works as an SRE engineer while finishing a university degree. My skill tree is a chaotic mess: I love picking up all sorts of random things, and I can do almost anything, though I would never claim to be great at everything.

Whenever I start digging into something new, I lose myself in it (lol) and somehow end up on a brand-new adventure. I enjoy philosophy, science, dabbling in literature, and writing small programs now and then. Lately I have been learning DTM music production, and I hope to see one of my tracks in a rhythm game someday!
story: I'm Miyago, someone who mixes engineering, creative work, and online culture together.
I believe a personal brand is more than an image. It is the choices you have made, the paths you have walked, and the traces you leave on the internet.
This page collects my background, my ACG and internet-culture rabbit holes, side projects, and where to find me online.
